'''Chaim Samuel Hönig''' (1 February 1926<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://cmcc.ufabc.edu.br/index.php/module-eventos/27-noticias-cmcc/99-professor-chaim |title=Nota de falecimento do Prof. Dr. Chaim Samuel Hönig |access-date=2018-04-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180425184036/http://cmcc.ufabc.edu.br/index.php/module-eventos/27-noticias-cmcc/99-professor-chaim |archive-date=2018-04-25 }}</ref> – 19 March 2018) was a Brazilian mathematician. He was the main proposer of the Brazilian Mathematical Colloquium (1957), one of the founders of the Brazilian Mathematical Society (SBM), and its first president.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sbm.org.br/institucional/quem-somos/fundacao|title=Quem Somos – Fundação|access-date=2017-09-17|publisher=Sociedade Brasileira de Matemática|last=|first=|archive-date=2017-09-18|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170918021904/https://www.sbm.org.br/institucional/quem-somos/fundacao|url-status=live}}</ref> Hönig was a full professor at the [[Institute of Mathematics and Statistics]] of the [[University of São Paulo]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ime.usp.br/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=396&catid=28&Itemid=513&lang=pt-br|title=Docentes e Funcionários|date=|access-date=2017-09-19|publisher=Institute of Mathematics and Statistics|last=|first=|archive-date=2017-09-18|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170918064848/https://www.ime.usp.br/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=396&catid=28&Itemid=513&lang=pt-br|url-status=live}}</ref> and a member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.abc.org.br/centenario/?Chaim-Samuel-Honig|title=Membro da ABC|access-date=2017-09-20|publisher=URL ABC|last=|first=|archive-date=2017-09-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170920044832/http://www.abc.org.br/centenario/?Chaim-Samuel-Honig|url-status=live}}</ref> Hönig made relevant contributions to functional analysis.<ref name="AgenciaUSP">"Primeiro Colóquio Brasileiro de Matemática: uma breve apresentação da participação feminina", Angelica Raiz Calabria e Mariana Feiteiro Cavalari, 2004.[http://ojs.ifsp.edu.br/index.php/hipatia/article/download/438/69] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170918022239/http://ojs.ifsp.edu.br/index.php/hipatia/article/download/438/69|date=2017-09-18}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://repositorio.ufsc.br/bitstream/handle/123456789/116026/Anu%C3%A1rio%20da%20Faculdade%20de%20Filosofia%2C%20Ci%C3%AAncias%20e%20Letras%20da%20Universidade%20de%20S%C3%A3o%20Paulo-USP%2C%201952%2C%20SP%281%29.pdf?sequence=4&isAllowed=y|title=Anuário
